تحشوا (form I)
# تَحُشُّوا (taḥuššū) /ta.ħuʃ.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَشَّ (ḥašša)
# تُحَشُّوا (tuḥaššū) /tu.ħaʃ.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَشَّ (ḥašša)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
